units: USD millions; shares in millions; price USD/share

aws_growth.label: AWS growth in 2026
aws_growth.basis: Q4 2025 AWS growth was 24%; scenario band is a judgment, not guidance. Fades 2 percentage points annually.

retail_growth.label: North America growth in 2026
retail_growth.basis: FY2025 growth about 10%; declines 0.5 percentage points each year.

international_growth.label: International growth in 2026
international_growth.basis: FY2025 reported growth about 13%, currency-neutral about 10%; fades 0.5 points annually.

aws_predep_margin.label: AWS margin before PPE depreciation
aws_predep_margin.basis: Analyst allocation assumption; NOT a reported AWS EBITDA margin. Costs include SBC, content and operating rent. Review allocation in assumptions record.

na_predep_margin.label: North America margin before PPE depreciation
na_predep_margin.basis: Analyst assumption before PPE depreciation; improves 0.2 percentage points yearly.

capex_2026.label: 2026 cash investment ($m)
capex_2026.basis: Management February outlook about $200bn; mapping to cash investment and subsequent fade are analyst conventions.

wacc.label: WACC
wacc.basis: 10% hurdle assumption; not represented as an estimated market WACC. Market calibration still required.

terminal_growth.label: Terminal growth
terminal_growth.basis: Long-run nominal scenario assumption; must remain below WACC and terminal ROIC.

terminal_roic.label: Terminal incremental ROIC
terminal_roic.basis: Required reinvestment = terminal NOPAT x growth / ROIC; chosen range requires student defense.
